capability.definition: Typed operation offered under one semantic contract.

implementation.definition: Observed provider or implementation; unqualified until conformance evidence exists.

neighbor.definition: Adjacent owner imported through a named anti-corruption layer.

optional_extension.definition: Removable predictive, generative or agent proposal/method surface.

product.definition: Independently adopted, operated, supported and replaceable outcome promise.

semantic_contract.definition: Owner of exact identities, decisions, invariants and refusals.

standard.definition: External editioned specification; neither product nor provider qualification.
